{{recipesummary|category=Rice recipes|servings=4|time=1 hour|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]]

==Ingredients==

* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic cloves]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallots]], chopped
* ~½ cup dry [[Cookbook:Porcini Mushroom|porcini mushrooms]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Common Mushroom|white mushrooms]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 1½ cups risotto [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Wine|white wine]]
* 5 cups [[Cookbook:Broth|chicken broth]] or vegetable broth
* ¼ cup [[cookbook:Cream|heavy cream]]
* 1 cup choice of [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan]], Romano cheese, or Asiago cheese
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] and freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] to taste
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], chopped

==Procedure==

# Keep broth heated in a medium-size [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].
# On medium heat in a large pan combine butter, garlic or garlic oil, shallots, mushrooms, and rice.
# Heat for about 2 minutes, stirring well.
# Add white wine and let [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]] on low for 2 minutes.
# With lid off, add chicken or vegetable broth, add cream, and let simmer on low until liquid is absorbed, approximately 25 minutes, stirring regularly.
# Add cheese of choice and salt and pepper to taste.
# [[Cookbook:Garnish|Garnish]] with parsley and grated choice.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* May substitute vegetable broth for chicken broth.
* Plump, medium grain rice that contains a lot of starch, like Arborio or Carnaroli, are traditionally best. Other rices that work well are Roma, Nano, Maratelli, and Vialone.
